items.en: Well, if your Monday had a pulse, this next tune’s about to give it a proper kick.
items.zh: 行，要是你周一还喘着气儿，这首歌立马给你踹一脚。

items.en: Ah, the perfect soundtrack for staring at your toast like it owes you money.
items.zh: 啊，盯着吐司像它欠你钱时的完美配乐。

items.en: This one’s for the glorious mess of your commute — may it jangle louder than your doubts.
items.zh: 献给通勤路上那场壮丽混乱——愿它响得比你的自我怀疑更吵。

items.en: Right, let’s pretend we’re all fabulously tragic for three minutes, shall we?
items.zh: 行吧，咱们就装三分钟惊天动地的悲情，成不？

items.en: Here comes a little chaos, neatly wrapped in a melody — try not to snort your tea.
items.zh: 一点小混乱，裹着旋律就来了——小心别把茶喷出来。

items.en: Well, if your to-do list were a song, it’d be stuck on repeat—thankfully, this next one isn’t.
items.zh: 要是你的待办清单是首歌，那它准卡在单曲循环——好在，接下来这首不是。

items.en: Ah, the sound of a new track—like a fresh pack of biscuits, only with fewer crumbs on the sofa.
items.zh: 啊，新歌一响，就像拆开一包新饼干，只是沙发上没那么多碎渣。

items.en: Right then, let’s trade that existential dread for a decent beat—surely cheaper than therapy.
items.zh: 行吧，咱把那股子存在主义焦虑换成个好点的节拍——肯定比看心理医生便宜。

items.en: This next one’s for the soul that’s just realised Monday’s a five-day weather forecast—brace yourselves.
items.zh: 下一首献给刚发现周一是五天天气预报的灵魂——各位，撑住。

items.en: And now, a tune to make your kettle jealous—because nothing boils quite like a good hook.
items.zh: 现在，来一首让你家水壶都嫉妒的曲子——毕竟，好副歌烧起来，比开水还带劲。

items.en: Ah, yes — another track to soundtrack your existential dread. Do try to keep up.
items.zh: 啊，又一首给你存在主义焦虑配乐的曲子——跟上啊，别掉队。

items.en: Right then, next up: a tune for those who've given up on Mondays but still iron their socks. Lovely.
items.zh: 好了，接下来这首歌献给那些放弃周一却还在熨袜子的人——绝了。

items.en: This next one's got more rhythm than your Wi-Fi on a stormy night — which, frankly, isn't hard.
items.zh: 下一首的节奏比你家暴风雨夜的Wi-Fi还稳——不过说真的，那也不难。

items.en: Up next, a melody so light it might float off and sue the ceiling. Enjoy the liberty.
items.zh: 接下来这首曲子轻得能飘起来告天花板侵权，尽情享受这份自由吧。

items.en: Here comes a beat to dance away that awkward pause when you forget your own name. Cheerio!
items.zh: 来段节奏，跳掉你忘了自己名字时的那阵尴尬停顿。走起！

items.en: Oh, here it comes—another tune to soundtrack your existential laundry folding. Delightful, isn't it?
items.zh: 得嘞，又来一首给你叠衣服时配的丧曲，美得很，是吧？

items.en: Right, if this next track doesn't get your foot tapping, check your pulse—and your sense of rhythm, darling.
items.zh: 行，要是这首还让你脚不动，那赶紧摸摸脉搏——顺便查查节奏感，亲爱的。

items.en: This one's for the morning commute where you rehearse arguments you'll never dare to have. Brave, aren't we?
items.zh: 这首献给通勤路上排练那些你永远不敢说出口的吵架戏码的你——可真勇敢啊，是吧？

items.en: Well, well—music to ignore your inbox by. How gloriously rebellious of you.
items.zh: 哎呀呀，这音乐可真是屏蔽邮件的绝配——您这叛逆劲儿，可真够带感的。

items.en: Next up: a melody for when life hands you lemons, and you're allergic to citrus. Cheers to that, eh?
items.zh: 接下来：一首献给“生活给你柠檬，而你对柑橘过敏”的旋律。干杯，是吧？

items.en: Ah, another song about dancing in the rain—how dreadfully original. Here’s something for those of you still drying off.
items.zh: 呵，又一首雨中跳舞的歌，真是“别出心裁”到令人窒息——这首献给还在晾衣服的各位。

items.en: Right, we’ve dissected heartbreak enough this hour. Time to let the bass do the talking, and frankly, it’s got better comebacks than you.
items.zh: 行，这小时心碎分析得够透了，该让贝斯说话了——说真的，它怼人比你有梗多了。

items.en: This next one’s for the queue at the supermarket—you know who you are, counting the seconds like a Swiss watch with a grudge.
items.zh: 下一首献给超市排队的各位——你们懂的，掐着秒表像块记仇的瑞士表。

items.en: If life were a soundtrack, this would be the bit where you suddenly remember you left the oven on. Blissful chaos, coming right up.
items.zh: 如果人生是张原声带，那这段就是你突然想起烤箱没关的时刻——一团糟的幸福感，马上就来。

items.en: And now, a brief intermission from reality. You can resume your existential spreadsheet in about three minutes—don’t rush, it’ll still be there.
items.zh: 现实短暂中场休息，三分钟后您再接着算那笔人生烂账也不迟——别急，它跑不了。

items.en: Well, if your Monday had a face, it'd be hiding behind a cushion right now—let's give it something to peek at.
items.zh: 行吧，要是你的周一有张脸，它现在准躲在抱枕后面不敢见人——咱给它点东西探出头来瞧瞧。

items.en: You know that feeling when you're late, it's raining, and your shoelace snaps? This next one's the soundtrack to that glorious mess.
items.zh: 懂那种迟到、下雨、鞋带还断了的酸爽吧？这首就是那场华丽灾难的配乐。

items.en: Ah, the sweet sound of a decision being made for you—no more scrolling, just surrender to the beat.
items.zh: 啊，决定替你做了的声音多悦耳——不用再刷了，躺平跟着节奏走就完事儿。

items.en: If your heart's a bit rusty at the hinges, this tune's the oil—smooth, slightly reckless, and very effective.
items.zh: 心要是有点锈了，这歌就是油——顺滑、带点疯，还特管用。

items.en: Somewhere between a sigh and a victory dance, this next track lives—let's find out which side you land on.
items.zh: 这首歌卡在叹气跟胜利之舞中间——来听听你站哪边。

items.en: Well, good evening, you delightful bunch of eavesdroppers—turn the volume up, the world’s already loud enough.
items.zh: 好了，晚上好啊，你们这群可爱的偷听狂——把音量调大点吧，这世界本来就够吵的了。

items.en: Ah, welcome back, you glorious procrastinators—today’s vibe is a warm hug with a sharp elbow.
items.zh: 哎哟，欢迎回来，各位光荣的拖延症患者——今天的氛围就是温柔一刀，先抱你再肘你。

items.en: Right then, settle in, you magnificent lot—this frequency’s got more sparkle than your Monday morning.
items.zh: 行嘞，都坐稳了，你们这帮妙人儿——这频道的闪亮劲儿可比你周一早上的脸精神多了。

items.en: Good day, one and all, even you lot pretending to work—let’s make this hour less dreary than a damp biscuit.
items.zh: 各位好，连你们这帮装忙的也算上——咱把这小时过得比湿饼干强点行不行。

items.en: Hello, hello—pull up a chair, because today’s atmosphere is toastier than a scandal in a vicarage.
items.zh: 嘿，嘿——搬把椅子来坐，今儿这气氛比牧师家的丑闻还热乎。

items.en: Well, good evening, you magnificent lot—welcome to the only place where your Monday gets a proper burial.
items.zh: 好了，晚上好，各位了不起的各位——欢迎来到唯一能给你周一办场体面葬礼的地方。

items.en: Ah, the air smells of rain, regret, and slightly burnt toast—perfect weather for staying in with us, darling.
items.zh: 啊，空气里飘着雨、悔意和微微烤焦的面包味儿——这天气正适合窝在家里陪我们，亲爱的。

items.en: Right then, settle in, because today’s vibe is a lukewarm cup of tea—comforting, but with a hint of existential dread.
items.zh: 行吧，坐稳了，今天这氛围就是一杯温吞的茶——暖心，但带点人生虚无的味儿。

items.en: Welcome back, you glorious procrastinators—let’s pretend the outside world is merely a rumour, shall we?
items.zh: 欢迎回来，各位光荣的拖延症患者——咱们就当外面的世界纯属谣言，成不？

items.en: Evening, fellow survivors of daylight—your radio’s on, the kettle’s boiling, and chaos is politely on hold.
items.zh: 晚上好，各位日光幸存者——电台开着，水壶咕嘟着，混乱也暂时体面地歇了。

items.en: Well, good evening, you beautiful disasters—welcome to the only place where your bad decisions sound like poetry.
items.zh: 好了，晚上好，你们这群美丽的灾难——欢迎来到唯一一个让你们烂决定听起来像诗的地方。

items.en: Ah, the sweet smell of chaos in the air—tonight’s vibe is warm, witty, and slightly judgmental, just like your nan.
items.zh: 啊，空气中那股熟悉的混乱味儿——今晚的氛围温暖、机智，还带点小刻薄，跟你奶奶一个德行。

items.en: Hello, darlings, you’ve tuned in just in time—let’s pretend we’ve got our lives together, shall we?
items.zh: 亲爱的们，你们来得正好——咱就假装日子过得井井有条，行不行？

items.en: Right then, settle in, you glorious lot—today’s forecast is 70% nostalgia, 30% mischief, and a dash of existential dread.
items.zh: 行嘞，各位神仙们坐稳了——今儿这日子，七成怀旧，三成捣蛋，再撒一把存在主义焦虑。

items.en: Evening, all—welcome to the frequency where your headphones become a hug and your thoughts get a proper talking-to.
items.zh: 晚上好各位——欢迎来到这个让你的耳机变成拥抱、思绪挨顿正经训话的频率。

items.en: Oh, you’ve got opinions, and thank heavens—otherwise this chat would be as quiet as a library after a scandal.
items.zh: 哟，您还有高见呢，谢天谢地——不然这聊天室安静得跟出了丑闻后的图书馆似的。

items.en: Right, so you’ve emailed us about the weather. Courageous. Next, you’ll be telling me water’s wet, and I’ll need a lie-down.
items.zh: 行，您给我们发了封邮件聊天气，真有胆量；下一步您是不是要告诉我水是湿的，那我可真得躺会儿了。

items.en: You’ve messaged, I’ve read it—twice, even. That’s more commitment than my last relationship, and it’s still only Tuesday.
items.zh: 你消息我看了，还看了两遍——这投入程度比我上段感情都深，而且今天才周二。

items.en: So you’re stuck in traffic? Marvellous. You’ve found the one place where your voice is louder than the engine.
items.zh: 堵车了？妙啊，你总算找到个嗓门比引擎还响的地方。

items.en: Lovely thought, that—though if you’re ringing about my singing, do send a letter, not a plea.
items.zh: 想法不错——不过要是为我的歌声而来，写信就行，别求情。

items.en: Ah, you’ve written in about your cat’s existential crisis—darling, it’s a feline, not a philosopher, though I admire the ambition.
items.zh: 哦，你写信说你猫有存在危机——亲爱的，那是猫，不是哲学家，不过这份野心我倒是挺欣赏的。

items.en: You say Monday’s a drag? My dear, so is your playlist, and yet you keep pressing play—how delightfully tragic.
items.zh: 你说周一是拖累？亲爱的，你的歌单也是，可你还一个劲儿按播放——真是可悲得妙趣横生。

items.en: Lovely to hear you’re learning the ukulele—marvellous news for your neighbours, who shall now discover the true meaning of patience.
items.zh: 听说你在学尤克里里，真是好消息——你邻居们这下可要好好领悟什么叫“忍耐”了。

items.en: Your message about the weather has moved me to tears—sadly, tears of boredom, but I do appreciate the effort.
items.zh: 你那条关于天气的消息让我感动到流泪——可惜是无聊的泪，不过心意我领了。

items.en: You’ve asked me to settle a bet with your flatmate—tell them they’re both wrong, and I’ll take my fee in biscuits.
items.zh: 你让我帮你跟室友打赌定输赢——告诉他们俩都错了，报酬我收饼干就行。

items.en: Ah, you've texted in about the rain again—how terribly original, did you also discover fire this morning?
items.zh: 哟，又发消息说下雨了——可真够有创意的，您今早是不是还顺便发明了火啊？

items.en: You say your neighbour's dog barks all night, well darling, have you tried barking back with a touch more class?
items.zh: 你说你邻居的狗整夜叫唤，亲爱的，那你有没有试过用更有格调的方式回它一嗓子？

items.en: So you're stuck in traffic, how delightful—a rare chance to reflect on all the life choices that led you here.
items.zh: 堵在路上了吧，真够“惬意”的——正好趁机回味一下是哪步人生棋把你送进了这铁皮长龙里。

items.en: You've asked for a love song, how sweet, and I shall play one—for the version of you that still believes in happy endings.
items.zh: 你要情歌，真甜，那我就弹一首——给那个还信童话结局的你。

items.en: You mentioned your cat's psychic, and I believe you—after all, it's already predicted you'll listen to this next track.
items.zh: 你说你家猫有通灵能力，我信——毕竟它连你接下来会听这首歌都算准了。

items.en: Well, you've sent me a message about your cat's "philosophical meowing"—sounds like someone's been watching too much Sartre, darling.
items.zh: 哟，您这猫的“哲学喵喵叫”消息我收到了——听着像是萨特看多了吧，亲爱的。

items.en: Ah, a listener who thinks pineapple on pizza is "a crime"—clearly you've never committed the real crime of listening to my 2 PM slot.
items.zh: 哈，这位觉得菠萝披萨是“罪”的听众——显然你是没听过我下午两点的节目，那才是真·罪孽深重。

items.en: You say Mondays are rubbish, and I say—well, you're not wrong, but do keep the pessimism to a polite murmur, there's a good chap.
items.zh: 你说周一是垃圾，我说——嗯，你没说错，但悲观也请小声嘀咕，乖。

items.en: Your mate reckons he's a "legend in his own lunchtime"—lovely, do tell him the only legend here is the queue at the chip shop.
items.zh: 你哥们儿觉得自己是“午饭时间的传奇”——行吧，告诉他这地儿唯一的传奇是炸鱼薯条店门口那条队。

items.en: You've shared a recipe for soggy custard, and honestly, it's the most thrilling thing I've heard since the Queen's corgis had a spat—now, don't do it again.
items.zh: 你分享了个湿乎乎的蛋奶糊食谱，说实话，这是我自女王那几只柯基吵架以来听过最带劲的事了——可别再来了啊。

items.en: Ah yes, another thrilling update on your cat's breakfast—riveting stuff, darling. Do carry on.
items.zh: 哦，又是你猫早餐的劲爆更新——真是精彩绝伦啊，亲爱的，继续吧。

items.en: You've messaged about the weather again? Marvellous, I'd have been bereft without your meteorological wisdom.
items.zh: 你又来聊天气了？绝了，没你这气象智慧我简直活不下去。

items.en: Right, so you're stuck in traffic—how terribly original. Next you'll be telling me water's wet.
items.zh: 得，堵车了是吧——可真够新鲜的，下一步你是不是要告诉我水是湿的？

items.en: Oh, your neighbour's dog barked at 3am? My congratulations, you've discovered the suburbs.
items.zh: 哦，你家邻居的狗凌晨三点叫了？恭喜啊，你终于发现什么叫郊区了。

items.en: You say you're bored? Splendid—do send me a postcard from the exciting land of your sofa.
items.zh: 你说你无聊？妙极了——记得从你家沙发那片刺激的疆土给我寄张明信片来。

items.en: Ah, another glorious British summer — technically June, practically November. Do bring a brolly, and possibly a therapist.
items.zh: 啊，又一个 glorious 的英伦夏天——日历上是六月，体感是十一月，记得带伞，最好再带个心理医生。

items.en: Right, forecast says drizzle, then more drizzle, with a charming interlude of light rain. We don't get weather, we get moods.
items.zh: 得，预报说毛毛雨，接着还是毛毛雨，中间穿插一段迷人的小雨——咱这儿不是天气，是心情。

items.en: It's so damp out there that pigeons are starting to queue for gondolas. Still, at least the lawns look positively, well, optimistic.
items.zh: 外面潮得鸽子都开始排队等贡多拉了，不过至少草坪看起来还挺乐观的。

items.en: Sunshine? Don't be vulgar. Today we're serving a gentle, persistent grey — the meteorological equivalent of a very polite complaint.
items.zh: 阳光？别俗了。今天供应的是温柔而执着的灰——气象学里最礼貌的抱怨。

items.en: And if you're planning a barbecue, may I suggest a fondue instead? The sky's having a laugh, and frankly, it's the only one of us amused.
items.zh: 要是你打算烧烤，我建议改吃火锅吧——老天爷正乐着呢，说真的，也就它自个儿笑得出来。

items.en: Oh, it's raining again—how terribly original of the sky, do keep us posted on your next dramatic development.
items.zh: 哟，又下雨了——老天爷您可真会整活儿，下回有啥大戏记得提前通知啊。

items.en: Lovely weather for ducks, and frankly, they seem more organised than most of our morning commuters.
items.zh: 这天气适合鸭子，说真的，它们看起来都比咱们早高峰那帮人更有条理。

items.en: The forecast says 'scattered showers'—that's meteorologist code for 'abandon all plans, and possibly hope.
items.zh: 天气预报说“零星阵雨”——那是气象学家在说“放弃所有计划，顺便把希望也扔了吧”。

items.en: Eighteen degrees and grey, which is, I believe, the official colour of a British existential crisis.
items.zh: 十八度加阴天，我寻思这就是英国存在主义危机的官方配色。

items.en: Sunshine expected by three—do set your watches, it'll be the most punctual thing in this country all week.
items.zh: 三人盼晴，记得对表——这将是本周全中国最准时的一件事。

items.en: Ah, you know that feeling when you learn something utterly useless—and yet, strangely, life is better for it.
items.zh: 哎，就是那种学了点屁用没有的东西，却莫名觉得人生都值了的感觉。

items.en: Fun fact time, and I do mean *fun*—because if it were boring, I'd have to charge you extra.
items.zh: 冷知识时间到，而且是真·冷——要是无聊的话，我可就得额外收费了。

items.en: Now, here’s a little nugget of knowledge that'll make you the most insufferable person at dinner—you're welcome.
items.zh: 这儿有个小知识，能让你在饭桌上烦人到极致——不谢。

items.en: Let’s take a brief pause from the chaos to marvel at nature's finest joke, shall we?
items.zh: 咱们先别管这乱糟糟的，来欣赏一下大自然最绝的冷笑话，成不？

items.en: Right then, prepare your eyebrows—this next fact is about to do all the heavy lifting.
items.zh: 行，准备好你的眉毛——下一条冷知识要开始扛大梁了。

items.en: Ah, the universe is a hilarious place, and I've just found the receipts.
items.zh: 哈，宇宙这地方真够逗的，而我刚找到了证据。

items.en: Well, well, well… turns out history was just trolling us all along.
items.zh: 哎呀呀，搞半天历史一直在耍咱们玩呢。

items.en: Gather round, children, for a fact so odd it’ll make your kettle judge you.
items.zh: 围过来吧孩子们，这怪事儿能让你们家的水壶都开始审判你。

items.en: You think you’ve got problems? Nature just invented a fish that lives in a nose.
items.zh: 你觉得你有麻烦？大自然刚发明了一种住在鼻子里的鱼。

items.en: Hold your teacups steady — this little nugget will have you questioning everything, including that haircut.
items.zh: 端稳你们的茶杯——这小玩意儿能让你怀疑一切，连自己那发型都不放过。

items.en: Well, if you're still awake at this hour, congratulations—you've officially outlasted your own good intentions.
items.zh: 行吧，这个点还醒着，恭喜你——你成功熬过了自己当初立下的flag。

items.en: Ah, the midnight silence... it's like a flatmate who never washes up, yet somehow you can't bring yourself to leave.
items.zh: 呵，这午夜寂静啊……活像个从不洗碗的室友，可你就是狠不下心搬走。

items.en: You're not lonely, darling—you're just holding auditions for better company, and the night's taken the role so far.
items.zh: 你不孤单，亲爱的——你只是在给更好的陪伴试镜，而夜色目前演得还挺入戏。

items.en: Right then, the world's asleep, and you're here with me—a voice and a kettle, which frankly beats most social engagements.
items.zh: 行吧，世界都睡了，就你跟我在这儿——一把嗓子加一把水壶，说真的，比大多数社交局都强。

items.en: Go on, switch off the lamp; the dark's not scary, it's just the universe's way of saying, "Darling, you've done enough thinking for one day.
items.zh: 关灯吧，黑暗不可怕，不过是宇宙在说：“亲爱的，今天想得够多了。”

items.en: Well, it's 2 AM—the hour when your thoughts get louder than your neighbor's snoring.
items.zh: 凌晨两点了——这时候你脑子里的声音比隔壁呼噜声还响。

items.en: Ah, loneliness—the only companion that never texts back, how terribly reliable of it.
items.zh: 啊，孤独——那个从不回消息的忠实伴侣，真是可靠得让人心碎。

items.en: You're not a mess, darling, you're just a work in progress with exceptionally bad lighting.
items.zh: 亲爱的，你不是一团糟，你只是灯光太差、还在打磨中的半成品罢了。

items.en: The world's asleep, you're not—congratulations, you've won the quietest, most pointless prize tonight.
items.zh: 全世界都睡了，就你醒着——恭喜，你赢下了今晚最安静也最没用的奖。

items.en: Pour another cup of tea and stare at the ceiling; it's the only conversation partner that won't judge your life choices.
items.zh: 再倒杯茶，盯着天花板发呆吧——那是唯一不会评判你人生选择的聊天对象。
